findings.reason: a control that cannot fail measures nothing, and the node would ship a done-when whose negative control is silently green; the fix is to pin the control's catalogue to a DD where psi_like exists or to use a DDv4-present class (e.g. ip_like on magnetics/ip at a source COCOS where its factor is -1, as the landed test already does on pf_active/coil/current/data at COCOS 6).
findings.text: the must-fail control is pinned to a DD path "the resolver classes psi_like (such as magnetics/flux_loop/flux/data)", but that path is psi_like only under DD 3.x; under the DD the JT-60SA map declares (4.1.1, machine_map.json:3) and the engine serves (DDv4), _target_cocos_transformation('4.1.1','magnetics/flux_loop/flux/data') returns None, and DD 4.0.0/4.1.1 carry zero psi_like labels at all (only ip_like on magnetics/ip and b0_like on magnetics/diamagnetic_flux exist), so mutating the resolver psi_like→one_like cannot move any binding's exported scale and the control can never fail
